en: The Liṅga worshipped by Brahmā, Murāri, and the gods; the Liṅga resplendent with stainless luster;
the Liṅga that destroys the suffering born of birth.
Therefore, I perpetually bow to that Śivaliṅga. || 1 ||
The Liṅga worshipped by the foremost of gods and sages;
the Liṅga that is the source of compassion for the burner of Kama;
the Liṅga that destroyed the pride of Ravana.
Therefore, I perpetually bow to that Liṅga of Sadāśiva. 2.
The Linga thoroughly anointed with all fragrant substances;
the Linga which is the cause for increasing the intellect;
the Linga worshipped by Siddhas, gods, and asuras.
Therefore, I perpetually bow to that Sadāśiva-liṅga. 3.
The Liṅga adorned with great jewels of gold, the Liṅga beautified by the encircling of the Lord of Serpents,
the Liṅga that destroyed the excellent sacrifice of Dakṣa.
Therefore, I perpetually bow to that Sadāśiva-liṅga. || 4 ||
The Liṅga anointed with saffron and sandalwood;
the Liṅga beautifully adorned with lotuses and necklaces;
the Liṅga that destroys accumulated sins.
Therefore, I perpetually bow to that Sadāśiva-liṅga. 5.
The Liṅga worshipped and served by the hosts of gods, the Liṅga through [pure] dispositions and indeed through acts of devotion,
the Liṅga possessing the radiance of ten million suns.
Therefore, I ever bow to that Sadāśiva-liṅga. || 6 ||
The liṅga resting upon an eight-petalled lotus,
the liṅga that is the cause of the origin of all things,
the liṅga that destroys the eight types of poverty.
Therefore, I bow forever to that Sadāśiva-liṅga. 7.
The Linga worshipped by the preceptor of the gods and the best of deities;
the Linga constantly honored with the flowers of the celestial grove;
the supreme Linga of the Self, higher than the highest.
Therefore, I perpetually bow to that Sadāśiva-liṅga. || 8 ||
Whoever recites this meritorious *Liṅgāṣṭaka* in the presence of Śiva attains the world of Śiva and rejoices together with Śiva.
